Worth It? 👀🇳🇬 ₦5,000 (US$3) Nigerian Street Food in Lagos. I stopped at a busy roadside food stall on Allen Avenue in Lagos to see what a ₦5,000 meal gets you in Nigeria. All the food is displayed on the side of the road. They had everything from giant fish to jollof rice, coconut rice, fried chicken and sweet plantains. I skipped the mystery fish 😅 and went for chicken, coconut rice and plantains instead. The verdict? The plantains were delicious, the chicken was a little tough and cold, and the coconut rice tasted a bit fishy for my liking. Considering the price, I’d still give it a 7/10 just because the people were really nice and friendly. One thing to keep in mind: this is real roadside street food. If hygiene is your top priority, this probably isn’t your scene. But if you love experiencing authentic local Nigerian food in Lagos, it’s definitely an interesting stop. ❤️🇳🇬 #nigeria #streefood #lagos

This routine is for anyone who is not dealing with extreme damage but wants over all glossier & softer hair this is the the exact routine I built for getting glass hair on fine hair but will work for the wavy curly hair girls too!!  the science: the flatten your cuticle lies, the more light it reflects that's what gives the illusion of glass. glossy hair isn't a product, it's the consistency of routine over time that’s keeping that cuticle smooth from prewash to final styling  it took me a while to figure out the system, but once I did, the results compounded and now I wanna share my favourite tips with you because this is the routine that actually for every  wash day. the 5 things I never skip: 1. always create a barrier before shampoo: hair oil or conditioner first. less friction = less cuticle damage = more shine 2. weekly hair mask. deep hydration is what keeps that cuticle flat and the shine consistent. 3. a glossing treatment every 3-4 weeks  this is the step that takes glossy to glass  4. leave-in conditioner every single wash. beats frizz and keeps the cuticle flat between washes. 5. the hair sandwich method oil before heat styling AND after. then always finish with a cool shot to lock the cuticle in place ✨ Hope these haircare tips help you guys!! #hair #haircare #glasshair #hairgloss

bakery style oreo stuffed cookies 🍪🥛    recipe: ingredients: ¾ cup salted butter, softened (170 g) ¾ cup packed brown sugar (150 g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50 g) 1 large egg  1 tsp vanilla (5 g) 2 cups all-purpose flour (240 g) 1 tbsp cornstarch (8 g) ½ tsp baking soda (3 g) ¼ tsp salt (1.5 g) oreos, some whole some  roughly chopped  white chocolate (measure with your heart)  & choceur cookie and cream chocolate’s   instructions: cream the butter and sugars together  until smooth and slightly fluffy. mix in the egg and vanilla until fully combined. in a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt. fold the dry ingredients into the wet just until combined.  chop some of the oreos into small chunks ( leave some for topping ) and fold them in along with the white chocolate. scoop the dough into 8 portions, flatten and add an oreo inside and chocolate then shape into tall mounds.
